name: Test · 32 Game summary email (code hook → LLM → Gmail)
description: Agent example for the Gmail + LLM gateway flow. The game calls this agent's code hook when a game ends with an email address; an LLM step writes a short upbeat summary and the Gmail connector sends it from the bound mailbox. In production the LLM runs through the LLM gateway and Gmail through the `gmail` alias bound in Production → Config → Connections — no keys in the app.

config.systemPrompt: You write one-sentence tic-tac-toe recaps for an email. You already have every detail you need. Never ask questions, never add greetings or markdown. Reply with the recap sentence only.
config.prompt: Game result: {{input.winner}}. Moves played: {{input.moves}}. Write one short, friendly sentence that states the result and the move count, e.g. "X won in 7 moves - nicely played!" or "A hard-fought draw after 9 moves!".
